posts.title: The Test Passed With the Code Deleted
posts.description: Coverage tells you a test ran. It does not tell you the test would fail if the code were wrong. Before an AI refactors your core, you need the second thing.

posts.title: An AI Wrote 200% Where It Meant 20%. The Bound Caught It.
posts.description: Confidence is what the model thinks of itself. Bounds are what your system thinks of the model. They are independent signals; use both.

posts.title: Don't Delete the Row. Delete the Key.
posts.description: Append-only history and GDPR-style erasure look incompatible. They are not, if you put the secret in two places.
